scientific_role: private provider-side evidence used only to estimate rho-conditioned I1 sigma surfaces after A_i(rho_region) has been frozen from the independent region-construction corpus

frozen_physical_reference.provenance: same frozen Phase-1 matched diagnostic regime as the region-construction corpus

acquisition.reason_common_bank: one composed native run per seed yields the three provider-local ledgers under the same workload realization while preserving independent provider RNG streams

provider_ledger.emission_semantics: arrival time at the provider, not root-source emission
provider_ledger.completion_semantics: provider completion if completed by simulation stop; otherwise null
provider_ledger.latency_semantics: provider completion minus provider arrival, including provider queue waiting and native service time
provider_ledger.cost_semantics: native COST(node)*service for the provider module only
provider_ledger.arrival_reconstruction: Fpre completion plus frozen branch-link transmission/propagation delay; cross-checked against native provider time_reception when a provider metric row exists

privacy_firewall.persistent_outputs: provider-local ledgers and acquisition manifests only
privacy_firewall.native_full-graph_traces: temporary and deleted after provider extraction
privacy_firewall.top_level_request_ledgers: temporary and deleted with native trace directory

freeze_rule: after successful acquisition and validation, this provider-local ledger corpus is immutable and is used only to estimate sigma_i(A_i(rho_region),H;rho_query) for regions already frozen from T_i^Gamma; it must never be used to fit or alter A_i
